name: Amapá
summary: Blue, green and yellow horizontal bands divided by thin black and white stripes, with a white outline of the Fortress of São José de Macapá at the hoist.
origin: The flag was chosen by a commission and set by Decree No. 8 of 23 April 1984 for the Federal Territory of Amapá. It was kept when Amapá became a state in 1988.

colors.name: Green
colors.meaning: The forests covering most of the state; hope.

colors.name: Yellow
colors.meaning: The federal union and rich soil.

colors.name: Black
colors.meaning: Those who died fighting for the region.

facts: The area was once disputed between France and Brazil.
The equator passes through Macapá, the capital.
clues: Blue, green and yellow bands with a white fortress outline.
A state crossed by the equator, once disputed with France.
